title: Christmas Donkeys
content: We took a walk to the farm to see Joy, the donkey who was born exactly one year ago.That’s Joy, the dark brown one one behind on the left. Lenny was asked to care for eight other donkeys temporarily. He needs to find homes for them because their owner died unexpectedly.I don’t even know the name of this donkey, but she was very friendly, nibbling on my fingers (and the sketchbook) as I did her portrait. Handsome, the barn cat, curled up on my lap and swung his tail across the drawing.-----Previously on GJ:Christmas Surprise (birth of Joy)Joy in the Farmyard (one week old)Donkey Portrait (Peanut)
